phase_name: CHGR Cross-Artifact Digest-Binding and Duplicate-Match Verification Repair Independent Verification
summary: Phase 146LV independently verified Phase 146L's verifier-only repair to src/pcae/governance/verification.py against CHGR-001 v1.3 Sec.30 (CHGR-REQ-210 through CHGR-REQ-216) without treating Phase 146L's own report, tests, or code comments as proof. Independently re-read the full contract text (Sec.30, CHGR-REQ-081/082, Sec.18 Security Contract) and the full source of verification.py, record.py, and governance_record.py directly. Constructed two genuine build_publication_record bundles (A, B) and ran a 36-scenario adversarial matrix directly against verify_artifact_at_path covering exact confirmation-reference matching, exact provenance-reference matching, directed integrity binding, duplicate-match rejection for all three roles, cross-bundle forgery (retargeted record_id, recomputed self-digest, retained donor content), and missing/extra-artifact handling -- every one of the 36 scenarios matched the frozen contract's required outcome exactly. Confirmed CLI-level argument-order determinism across three fresh-process pcae governance-record verify invocations (forward, reversed, interleaved) producing byte-identical outcomes, and confirmed CLI-level fail-closed exit codes (duplicate-match rejection exits 1). Ran the full live production workflow end to end through the real pcae CLI -- decision-session create/evidence/select/preview/confirm/readiness, governance-record publish/verify/inspect -- producing a fifth genuine bundle persisted to four real artifact files; verified exact siblings pass, a cryptographically re-signed cross-bundle confirmation forgery built from an unrelated separately-published bundle is rejected REFERENCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH, a duplicated genuine confirmation is rejected RELATED_ARTIFACT_AMBIGUOUS, and in-place tampering of both the primary record and a related artifact are each rejected DIGEST_MISMATCH -- all through the actual installed CLI binary. Independently reviewed all three fixtures Phase 146L migrated (valid_record_published.json, valid_integrity.json, adversarial_assurance_overclaim_selfconsistent.json): confirmed only digest fields changed, that the changes correctly cascade from correcting stale reference digests to point at real, unmodified sibling fixtures, and that the reciprocal CHGR-REQ-211 integrity binding remains internally consistent post-migration. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. Two Non-Blocking findings recorded: (NB-1) the implemented ambiguity gate groups candidates by record_id alone rather than CHGR-REQ-213's literal record_id-plus-record_family text, a stricter-not-weaker divergence that still rejects every case examined and is not exploitable given UUID4 record_id generation; (NB-2) malformed and self-tampered related-artifact candidates for all three roles share the DIGEST_MISMATCH code with primary-record self-inconsistency, a deliberate minimalism choice per Phase 146L's own commit rationale that does not weaken fail-closed behavior. Two Informational findings recorded: unreachable-in-practice semantic-check dead paths for confirmation/provenance (a structural consequence of record_digest covering the full payload, not a defect), and three pre-existing orphaned fixtures referenced by no test, predating both phases. No Blocking finding was identified under any of the Sec.19 criteria this phase's authorization specifies. Full detail in docs/PHASE_146LV_CHGR_CROSS_ARTIFACT_DIGEST_BINDING_AND_DUPLICATE_MATCH_VERIFICATION_REPAIR_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: No test file under tests/ was added, modified, or migrated by this phase. One optional independent adversarial verification script (36 scenarios) was written and executed from the session scratchpad directory outside the repository and is not part of this commit, per this phase's own No-Go Boundary (documentation and optional independent adversarial tests only, no repository test file).
